_comment: Noise-exclusion rules for broad keyword exports. An excluded keyword is written to excluded.csv together with the reason. Each rule: name, on (norm = normalised text, raw = original lowercased text), patterns (regex). Language rules look at the text before typo fixes. Edit or add rules per brief; run with --no-noise-filter to turn them off.

rules.name: retailer_brand_navigational
patterns: \b(amazon|walmart|etsy|ebay|costco|walgreens|cvs|hobby lobby|michaels|kohls|macys|nordstrom|temu|shein|aliexpress|alibaba|wayfair|home depot|lowes|best buy|ikea|dollar tree|bath and body works|build a bear|vistaprint|shutterfly|snapfish|uncommon goods|things remembered|personalization mall)\b

rules.name: account_support_reputation
patterns: \b(login|log in|sign in|sign up|my account|track(ing)? (my )?order|order status|customer service|customer support|phone number|contact us|refund|return policy|legit|scam|complaints?)\b

rules.name: local_intent
patterns: \b(in|near|around) (dc|d c|washington dc|nyc|new york city|manhattan|brooklyn|chicago|los angeles|la|boston|philadelphia|philly|san francisco|sf|seattle|atlanta|dallas|houston|miami|las vegas|vegas|orlando|nashville|denver|san diego|austin|portland|phoenix|detroit|minneapolis|new orleans|charlotte|baltimore|pittsburgh|st louis|tampa|san antonio|indianapolis|kansas city|sacramento|honolulu|london|manchester|birmingham|glasgow|edinburgh)\b

rules.name: media_brand_navigational
patterns: \b(good morning america|today show|nbc today|tonight show|kelly clarkson|drew barrymore|jimmy fallon|jimmy kimmel|ellen show|ellen degeneres)\b
\b(food network|hallmark channel|hgtv|martha stewart|pioneer woman|ina garten|barefoot contessa|joanna gaines|bon appetit|nyt cooking|allrecipes|betty crocker|pillsbury|butterball)\b

rules.name: restaurant_grocery_navigational
